svg.aria-label: At Aerem: 8.5ms Dispatch Planner report query (down from 455ms); 10–69× faster production Postgres queries (8 new indexes, verified across 48 scenarios); ₹2.13 Cr of duplicated credit notes removed (a race condition, found and fixed); ₹49.1 lakh of payments auto-matched (collections made double-post-proof); 298 false alerts, ended (Aerem’s first distributed tracing); 150 leaked Chromium processes, contained (pooled browser, concurrency cap, DLQ)
